before:
METHOD set_setting.
    DATA lt_specs TYPE tt_conf.
    DATA ls_spec TYPE zosd_l3_conf.
    DATA ls_row TYPE zosd_l3_conf.
    DATA ls_old TYPE zosd_l3_conf.
    rv_ok = abap_false.
    IF authorised( ) = abap_false OR valid( iv_param = iv_param iv_value = iv_value ) = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    lt_specs = specs( ).
    READ TABLE lt_specs INTO ls_spec WITH KEY param_name = iv_param.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    settings_seed( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM zosd_l3_conf INTO ls_row
      WHERE set_name = {{set | literal}} AND param_name = iv_param.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    ls_old = ls_row.
    ls_row-param_val = iv_value.
    ls_row-origin = 'USER'.
    ls_row-note_text = iv_note.
    ls_row-changed_by = sy-uname.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD ls_row-changed_at.
    UPDATE zosd_l3_conf FROM ls_row.
    audit( is_old = ls_old is_new = ls_row iv_note = iv_note ).
    rv_ok = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
after:
METHOD set_setting.
    DATA lt_specs TYPE tt_conf.
    DATA ls_spec TYPE zosd_l3_conf.
    DATA ls_row TYPE zosd_l3_conf.
    DATA ls_old TYPE zosd_l3_conf.
{{#governor}}
    DATA ls_current TYPE ty_state.
    DATA lv_warn TYPE i.
    DATA lv_narrow TYPE i.
{{/governor}}
    rv_ok = abap_false.
    IF authorised( ) = abap_false OR valid( iv_param = iv_param iv_value = iv_value ) = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    lt_specs = specs( ).
    READ TABLE lt_specs INTO ls_spec WITH KEY param_name = iv_param.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    settings_seed( ).
{{#governor}}
    IF iv_param = 'budget.warn' OR iv_param = 'budget.narrow_at'.
      " fixed lock order for concurrent edits of the two thresholds
      SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE * FROM zosd_l3_conf INTO ls_old
        WHERE set_name = {{set | literal}} AND param_name = 'budget.warn'.
      SELECT SINGLE FOR UPDATE * FROM zosd_l3_conf INTO ls_old
        WHERE set_name = {{set | literal}} AND param_name = 'budget.narrow_at'.
      ls_current = load( iv_write = abap_false ).
      lv_warn = {{warn}}.
      lv_narrow = {{narrow_at}}.
{{#settings.budget_warn}}
      lv_warn = ls_current-vals-budget_warn.
{{/settings.budget_warn}}
{{#settings.budget_narrow_at}}
      lv_narrow = ls_current-vals-budget_narrow_at.
{{/settings.budget_narrow_at}}
      IF iv_param = 'budget.warn'.
        lv_warn = iv_value.
      ELSE.
        lv_narrow = iv_value.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_warn > lv_narrow OR lv_narrow > 10000.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
{{/governor}}
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM zosd_l3_conf INTO ls_row
      WHERE set_name = {{set | literal}} AND param_name = iv_param.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    ls_old = ls_row.
    ls_row-param_val = iv_value.
    ls_row-origin = 'USER'.
    ls_row-note_text = iv_note.
    ls_row-changed_by = sy-uname.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD ls_row-changed_at.
    UPDATE zosd_l3_conf FROM ls_row.
    audit( is_old = ls_old is_new = ls_row iv_note = iv_note ).
    rv_ok = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
